about_short_description.short_description: WideBot AI is MENA's leading AI communication platform, focusing on customer experience and AI engagement.

product.name: WideBot AI Communication Platform
product.description: An omnichannel platform for automating, managing, and analyzing customer conversations across messaging, web, social, email, and SMS channels.

product.name: Chatbot Builder
product.description: A no-code platform for creating and managing AI chatbots with conversation flows, templates, integrations, analytics, and human-agent handover.

product.name: WhatsApp Automation
product.description: A WhatsApp chatbot and automation solution for customer support, personalized messaging, data collection, notifications, and integrations with business systems.

product.name: Conversational AI
product.description: AI capabilities for understanding customer messages, including intent classification, named-entity recognition, sentiment analysis, dialect identification, and language detection.

product.name: Enterprise Chatbot Solutions
product.description: Custom-built AI chatbot services covering planning, conversation design, development, integration, testing, launch, and performance measurement.

product.name: Professional Services
product.description: Expert services for conversation design and custom integrations, including chatbot flow development and API-based connections to business applications.
